item.title: For Dayton’s County Corp, creating generational wealth is the foundation - ThinkTV
item.description: Dayton and Montgomery County, like so many other places in the U.S., continue to face a shortage of low-income housing. For nearly fifty years the private nonprofit development corporation County Corp, has been creating generational wealth by adding new housing and working to revitalize neighborhoods.
